documents.title: High Altitude Acclimatization & AMS Safety Guidelines
documents.content:
High Altitude Travel & AMS Precautions:
1. Mandatory Acclimatization: On Day 1 in destinations above 2,500m (e.g. Leh, Gulmarg Phase 2, Rohtang), take strict physical rest. Avoid immediate uphill treks.
2. Hydration: Drink 3-4 Litres of water daily, along with herbal teas or Kehwa. Avoid heavy alcohol or dehydration.
3. Recognizing Symptoms: Headache, nausea, dizziness, or shortness of breath indicate AMS. Notify your guide or hotel immediately and do not ascend further.
4. Oxygen & Medical Aid: Keep portable oxygen cans handy. In Leh, visit SNM District Hospital. In J&K, reach local medical booths.
5. National Emergency Helplines: 112 (All-in-one Emergency), 1363 (Tourist Police), 108 (Ambulance), 1070 (Disaster Response SDRF).

documents.title: YatriSathi Sustainable Travel & Crowd Redistribution Philosophy
documents.content:
YatriSathi Platform Mission:
- Proactively redistributes tourist footfall from heavily congested commercial bottlenecks (e.g. Solang Valley, Baga Beach, Dal Lake) to authentic, serene offbeat alternatives (e.g. Sethan Valley, Galgibaga Turtle Beach, Doodhpathri).
- Benefits: Enhances traveler serenity, protects fragile mountain/coastal ecosystems, and directs tourist revenue to local village artisans, homestays, and family-run dhabas.
- Live Guardian: The background monitoring engine watches crowd densities and dynamically suggests 1-click alternative rerouting.
